title: Design, Synthesis, and Antiproliferative Evaluation of C3/C12-Modified Panaxadiol Derivatives Against Gastric Cancer Cells: Integrated Transcriptomic and Metabolomic Analyses.
snippet: Panaxadiol (PD) is a bioactive dammarane triterpenoid with limited antiproliferative potency, and systematic optimization of its C3 and C12 positions remains underexplored.
